# Canvas Game Idea

**Title:** Asteroid Dodge

**Gameplay:** Control a ship at the bottom of the canvas, moving left/right to avoid falling asteroids that spawn randomly and accelerate over time. Optionally fire a single shot to destroy an asteroid.

**Lose Condition:** The game ends when an asteroid collides with the ship or reaches the bottom of the canvas.
